$Comment: One of the Yeti's snowballs, falling straight down onto a ring marked under a player (the Horseman's volley bomb and the game's falling stalactite do the same): it appears 10 blocks above the ring, pointed down, and drops at 7 blocks a second, so a player has about a second and a half to step off the ring. The den and the hall are 14 blocks high, so there it always starts under the roof; over the low entrance passage it starts in the rock and bursts there, out of a player's reach. It is drawn as a big lump of snow (its own model, Christmas_Yeti_Snowball), which changes nothing it hits. It bursts as Christmas_Yeti_Snowball_Burst (players only) on whatever it strikes.
